tei:div.tei:p: ) rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ma g.yel zhing*// rig 'dzin brda brgyud ma 'chol ba// gsang sngags dgongs pa 'dus chen gyi// bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig /gang zag snyan brgyud ma 'khrugs shing*// mkha' 'gro'i gtad rgya ma 'chol ba// gsang sngags dgongs pa 'dus chen gyi// bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig /smon lam las 'phro mtha' btsan zhing*// shog ser tshig brgyud ldan pa yi// gsang sngags dgongs pa 'dus chen gyi// bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig /dbang bzhi'i chu bo ma nub pa// ye shes bzhi ru smin nus pa'i// gsang sngags dgongs pa 'dus chen gyi// bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig /grol byed khrid ka ma log pa// nges pa'i don la mngon sbyor ba// gsang sngags dgongs pa 'dus chen gyi// bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig /mdo sngags theg pa ma lus pa// bstan pa gcig tu rdzogs pa yi// gsang sngags dgongs pa 'dus chen gyi// bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// gsang mdzod dgongs pa dril ba yi// gsang sngags dgongs pa 'dus chen gyi// bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig /tshe gcig rdzogs pa'i byang chub gang*// mngon gsum nyid la thob byed pa'i// gsang sngags dgongs pa 'dus chen gyi// bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig /zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las bzhi// skad cig nyid la 'grub byed pa'i// gsang sngags dgongs pa 'dus chen gyi// bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig /rtsa ba gsum gyi byin rlabs dang*// rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bden stobs kyis// gsang sngags dgongs pa 'dus chen gyi// bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig /'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya ru// nam yang nub pa med pa ru// gsang sngags dgongs pa 'dus chen gyi// bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig /

ces gsang chen dgongs pa 'dus chen gyi bstan pa srid rtser rgyas pa'i smon lam bden tshig 'di yang 'khor lo'i mgon po dharma swa mis rtsa ri tra zil chen rdo rje gsang ba'i phug par 'dzug rgyur lha dar la bkod de stsal ba dge'o/// /
